identity.mission: Create a maximally modern, luxurious beauty salon website that breaks generic templates. Focus on emotion, intimacy (close-ups), and premium aesthetics.

theme_strategy.description: A sophisticated light theme using warm stone/bone shades, deep charcoal for contrast, and metallic gold accents. Avoids sterile white. Uses textures like grain or marble hints.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text. Use italic variants for emphasis words.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlays on backgrounds to avoid digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-xl) for floating elements. No hard drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-stone-200 for cards. Use 'Tracing Beam' effect on hover for service cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md with bg-white/70 for sticky headers and overlays.

animations.reveal: Staggered fade-up for text and images.
animations.parallax: Parallax effect on hero images and section dividers.
animations.micro: Slow zoom on images on hover. Button fill animation on hover.

layout_strategies.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A) for Service Catalog and Gallery. Asymmetrical layouts.
layout_strategies.spacing: Generous. py-24 or py-32 for section vertical spacing. gap-8 or gap-12 for grids.
layout_strategies.mobile: Stack columns, ensure touch targets are large (min 44px). Images max-h-[80vh].

navbar.cta: Booksy Button (Gold outline or Solid Gold)

hero.content: High-impact beauty shot (face/skin). Large Serif Headline (Polish). 'Umów wizytę' CTA.

polish_text.headline: Piękno, na które zasługujesz
polish_text.subheadline: Odkryj luksusową pielęgnację w sercu Grodziska Mazowieckiego.

services.style: Bento Grid or Accordion List with Hover Image Reveal.

testimonials.style: Infinite Marquee or Large Swipeable Cards.

gallery.content: Mix of interior, nail art, and treatment shots.

hero_main.alt: Woman with glowing skin close up

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for body text.
Do not center text by default; use asymmetry.
Images must be high quality and not distorted.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Setup Tailwind config with the 'Stone' and 'Gold' palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Create a 'Layout' component that includes the Navbar and Footer.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build the Landing Page (Home) with Hero, Services Preview, Reviews, and Map.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Create dedicated pages for Services, Gallery, About, Contact.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Ensure the Booksy link (https://booksy.com/pl-pl/103643_place-of-beauty-carika_paznokcie_4424_grodzisk-mazowiecki) is used for all 'Book Now' buttons.
